test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The study of earthquakes
solution: The correct answer is '**Seismology**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Seismology**'. • It means 'the scientific study of movements in the earth’s surface(earthquakes)'. [भूकंप-विज्ञान] • *Example: Large scale global **seismology** has helped to identify areas at risk from earthquakes and tsunami.* **Correct Answer:__** *Seismology.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Geography**: the study of the world’s surface, physical qualities, climate, population, products, etc. [विश्‍व भूगोल की सतह, भौतिक लक्षण, मौसम, जनसंख्‍या आदि का अध्‍ययन] • **Topography**: the physical characteristics of an area of land, especially the position of its rivers, mountains, etc. [किसी क्षेत्र की प्राकृतिक विशेषताएँ (विशेषतः नदियों, पर्वतों आदि की स्थिति); स्‍थलाकृति] • **Geology**: is the scientific study of the Earth, its structure, composition, and the processes that shape it over time. the study of rocks, and of the way they are formed. (चट्टानों और उनके निर्माण-प्रकार का अध्‍ययन; भूविज्ञान) 37:T61e, The correct answer is '**achieving**'.
